answers.explanation: Batch monthly Fargate = EventBridge schedule rule + ECS RunTask target. No ALB/CloudFront/NAT scheduling. night-12-eventbridge-schedule.md decision tree.
ECS targets require RoleArn trusted by events.amazonaws.com with ecs:RunTask + PassRole. FailedInvocations usually IAM/target config. night-12-lab troubleshooting order.
Scheduled RunTask is still awsvpc Fargate — needs same private subnets, SG, NAT path as Night 10. EventBridge does not pick networking for you.
EventBridge cron: minutes hours day-of-month month day-of-week year → cron(0 6 1 * ? *) = 06:00 UTC on the 1st. rate(1 month) is invalid.
EventBridge assumes the target role on the rule — separate from CI user credentials. eventbridge-ecs-trust-policy.json.
Decouple + buffer + async consumer pace = SQS (Night 13). EventBridge schedule is for time-based triggers, not workload buffering.
FailedInvocations = EventBridge failed to deliver to target (often IAM). Container exit 1 is after task started — watch ECS events or logs instead.
Classic EventBridge ECS target role trust principal is events.amazonaws.com. Scheduler uses scheduler.amazonaws.com for its execution role — related but distinct.
EventBridge Scheduler supports one-time schedules, flexible windows, and retries. Classic rate/cron rules are simpler but less flexible.
Night 11 preview in night-11-elb-theory.md — batch RunTask needs no LB; ALB for long-running HTTP services.
Cluster condition in eventbridge-ecs-run-policy.json limits RunTask blast radius — least privilege for exam and production.
ECS Task State Change on default bus = event pattern rule. Iceland monthly rule = schedule expression rule.
Fargate cost dominates; rate(1 minute) would run Iceland constantly. Restore monthly cron after --test-fire validation.
PassRole to ECS tasks requires iam:PassedToService = ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com — same as github-actions-policy-v4.json Night 5.
Night 12 kicks off batch on schedule; Night 13 SQS decouples completion handling from the runner — classic integration pattern split.
